title: Contact Us

body: If you have a question or comment about the site or would like more information about lawn bowling please email us using the form to the right.

sections.heading: Contact form
body: The contact form is being rebuilt and is temporarily unavailable.

formSpec.purpose: Sends a general question or comment about the site or about lawn bowling to the Southwest Division.

fields.label: Name
fields.notes: Squarespace 'name' field — first name and last name sub-inputs.

formSpec.notes: Squarespace form block, formId 5ffde55b1aedad21443b3ec0, form name "Comment". CAPTCHA enabled. On success it shows an inline message, "Thank you for contacting us!!" — no redirect. The submission destination (Squarespace-stored submissions and/or a notification email address) is not exposed in the page HTML and must be read from the Squarespace form's Storage tab before rebuilding.

migrationNotes: The page said the form was 'to the right'; in the migrated single-column layout it now follows the intro paragraph.
The Squarespace form itself was not migrated — see formSpec for its exact specification.
